papers.title_en: Gait variability and biomechanical distinctions in individuals with functional ankle instability: a case–control study based on three-dimensional motion analysis
papers.title_zh: 功能性踝关节不稳患者的步态变异性和生物力学特征：一项基于三维运动分析的病例对照研究
papers.tldr_en: Post-traumatic degradation of peripheral sensorimotor feedback following ankle injury induces central nervous system-mediated motor control reorganization, resulting in altered movement strategies that manifest through modified kinematic coordination patterns across the hip, knee, and ankle joints.
papers.abstract_en: Ankle sprains, the most common sports injury, often progress to functional ankle instability (FAI), characterized by recurrent instability and neuromuscular deficits. This study utilizes three-dimensional (3D) gait analysis system to quantify lower limb biomechanical alterations in FAI during gait, aiming to identify objective markers for guiding targeted rehabilitation strategies. This case–control study enrolled 31 matched subject pairs (FAI subjects vs. healthy controls) through propensity score matching based on stringent inclusion/exclusion criteria. papers.abstract_zh: 踝关节扭伤是最常见的运动损伤，常进展为功能性踝关节不稳（FAI），其特征是反复发作的不稳和神经肌肉功能缺陷。本研究利用三维（3D）步态分析系统量化FAI患者步态期间的下肢生物力学改变，旨在识别客观指标以指导靶向康复策略。这项病例对照研究根据严格的纳入/排除标准，通过倾向性评分匹配招募了31对匹配受试者（FAI患者 vs. 健康对照）。收集了人口学数据，并...

papers.title_en: Effects of Plyometric Training on Physical Fitness Attributes in Handball Players: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
papers.title_zh: 增强式训练对手球运动员身体素质属性的影响：一项系统评价和荟萃分析
papers.tldr_en: In conclusion, plyometric training effectively improves various physical fitness attributes, including jump performance, linear sprint ability, maximal strength, muscle power and agility.
papers.abstract_en: This meta-analysis aimed to examine the effects of plyometric training on physical fitness attributes in handball players. A systematic literature search across PubMed, SCOPUS, SPORTDiscus, and Web of Science identified 20 studies with 563 players. Plyometric training showed significant medium-to-large effects on various attributes: countermovement jump with arms (ES = 1.84), countermovement jump (ES = 1.33), squat jump (ES = 1.17), and horizontal jump (ES = 0.83), ≤ 10-m linear sprint time (ES = -1.12), > 10-m linear sprint time (ES = -1.46), repeated sprint ability with change-of-direction time (ES = -1.53), agility (ES = -1.60), maximal strength (ES = 0.52), and force-velocity (muscle power) (ES = 1.13). papers.abstract_zh: 本荟萃分析旨在探讨增强式训练对手球运动员身体素质属性的影响。通过对PubMed、SCOPUS、SPORTDiscus和Web of Science进行系统文献检索，共识别出20项研究，涉及563名运动员。增强式训练对多项属性显示出显著的中到大效应：摆臂反向跳（ES = 1.84）、反向跳（ES = 1.33）、深蹲跳（ES = 1.17）和水平跳（ES = 0.83），≤ 10米直线冲刺时间（ES = -1.12），> 10米直线冲刺时间（ES = -1.46），以及带变向的重复冲刺能力...

papers.title_en: Ergonutrition Supplementation and Recovery in Water Polo: A Systematic Review
papers.title_zh: 运动营养补充与水球运动员恢复：一项系统评价
papers.tldr_en: Adequate ergogenic nutrition adapted to the needs of WP players is essential not only to optimize their athletic performance but also to ensure effective recovery and maintain their long-term health and general well-being.
papers.abstract_en: Background: Water polo (WP) is a high-intensity team sport that requires a combination of physical endurance, muscular strength, speed, and specific technical skills. Due to the demanding and prolonged nature of this sport, adequate and balanced nutrition plays a fundamental role in athletes’ performance, recovery, and overall health maintenance. Objectives: We aimed to compile all available information on the importance of ergonutrition and supplementation in the recovery of WP players. This will help in understanding this sport’s specific challenges and requirements, enabling players and coaches to design more effective recovery plans to optimize performance, achieve goals, and successfully cope with intense training and competition. papers.abstract_zh: 背景：水球（WP）是一项高强度团队运动，需要结合体能耐力、肌肉力量、速度和特定的技术技能。由于这项运动要求高且持续时间长，充足和均衡的营养在运动员的表现、恢复和整体健康维护中起着基础性作用。目的：我们旨在汇集所有关于运动营养和补充剂在水球运动员恢复中重要性的现有信息。这将有助于理解这项运动的特定挑战和要求，使运动员和教练能够...

papers.title_en: Injury risk analysis of movement restriction and body asymmetry in sports injury prediction
papers.title_zh: 运动受限和身体不对称性在运动损伤预测中的风险分析
papers.journal: BMC Sports Science Medicine and Rehabilitation
papers.journal_tier: 康复医学2区/运动科学3区
papers.tldr_en: Significant restrictions in knee and shoulder mobility and body asymmetry were associated with increased injury risk and targeted interventions such as personalized exercise regimens and movement retraining may help mitigate these biomechanical risk factors.
papers.abstract_en: Sports injuries remain a major concern for athletes and fitness enthusiasts, affecting performance and long-term well-being. Effective prediction and prevention strategies are critical for reducing injury incidence. This study investigates the predictive roles of movement restriction and body asymmetry in sports injury risk. Sports injuries remain a major concern for athletes and fitness enthusiasts, affecting performance and long-term well-being. Effective prediction and prevention strategies are critical for reducing injury incidence. This study investigates the predictive roles of movement restriction and body asymmetry in sports injury risk. Significant restrictions in knee and shoulder mobility were associated with increased injury risk. papers.title_en: Effects of Exercise Frequency with Complex Contrast Training on Measures of Physical Fitness in Active Adult Males
papers.title_zh: 复合对比训练运动频率对活跃成年男性体能指标的影响
papers.tldr_en: Compared to active controls, the load-equated CCT-2 and CCT3 programs provided similar effects on measures of physical fitness in active adult males, however, an athlete’s goal is to improve their MAT score, theCCT-3 program may elicit greater improvements compared with the C CT-2 program.
papers.abstract_en: Complex contrast training (CCT) is an exercise modality that utilizes both high-load resistance activity and low-load plyometric activity in a set-by-set fashion within a single exercise session. Such a combination of exercises targets multiple aspects of the force–velocity curve and may thus lead to improvement of various components of physical fitness. However, no previous study has attempted to compare the effects of load-equated two vs. three CCT sessions per week on measures of physical fitness. Forty-five male participants aged 21.4 ± 2.0 years were randomly assigned to either two weekly CCT sessions (CCT-2; n = 15), three weekly CCT sessions (CCT-3; n = 15), or an active control group (CG; n = 15). papers.title_en: Building for the Future: A Systematic Review of the Effects of Eccentric Resistance Training on Measures of Physical Performance in Youth Athletes
papers.title_zh: 展望未来：离心抗阻训练对青少年运动员体能指标影响的系统评价
papers.tldr_en: The findings of this systematic review support the inclusion of eccentric resistance training in youth athletes to improve measures of muscular strength, jump, sprint and change of direction performance.
papers.abstract_en: Background Eccentric resistance training is recognised as an effective stimulus for enhancing measures of muscular strength and power in adult populations; however, its value in youth athletes is currently not well understood. Objective The aim of this systematic review was to critically appraise the effects of eccentric resistance training on measures of physical performance (i.e. muscular strength, jump, sprint and change of direction) in youth athletes 18 years of age and under. Methods Original journal articles published between 1950 and June 2022 were retrieved from electronic search engines of PubMed, SPORTDiscus and Google Scholar’s advanced search option.
